notes.title: Visual Novel Festival
notes.notes:
Friends and fans of magical stories!

We invite you to the Visual Novel Festival, where thrilling stories, mystical worlds, and unforgettable characters await you!

Special event: testing the demo version of our novel! You will have the chance to immerse yourself in a world of magic, sorcery, and secrets of the magical university. Your feedback will help us make the game even better!

notes.title: Steam Next Fest - Today
notes.notes:
The four witches wish everyone a great festival.
Enjoy the games and have a great time.
Good luck to everyone!

notes.title: There are more and more characters :)
notes.notes: [img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45216119/a0abb46b9cb88f3576e278b96cd53db678930342.png[/img]The world of our game is expanding as more and more characters come to life, each bringing new depth and intrigue to the story. Development is in full swing, and with every step forward, the plot becomes richer and more immersive. We’re diving deeper into the themes of magic, power, and the supernatural, crafting a narrative that will keep players engaged and eager to uncover its secrets. Thank you for your interest and support—there’s much more to come!

notes.title: Новый год, новый семестр в университете Магии!
notes.notes:
Наши юные ведьмы успешно сдали экзамены и готовы к новому семестру!
Новый семестр принесет им много новых и захватывающих испытаний!

Друзья. Желаю, чтобы 2025 год стал лучшим для всех.
